findings.documented: Every request must carry the API key you were issued. Append it as a query parameter: ?api_key=IVY26-XXXXXXXXXXXX
findings.actual: Requests fail with 'missing X-API-Key header'. The API key must be sent as an HTTP header 'X-API-Key'.
findings.how_found: Passed api_key as a query parameter to /auth/login and /v1/listings, which failed until passed as X-API-Key header.
findings.impact: Authentication fails for all requests if passed via query param as documented.

findings.documented: Returns token (valid for 86400s / 24 hours), token_type: Bearer, and user object with no refresh flow.
findings.actual: Returns access_token instead of token, expires_in is 900 seconds (15 minutes), and provides refresh_token with refresh_url: /auth/refresh.
findings.how_found: Inspected the successful response payload from POST /auth/login.
findings.impact: Frontend looking for res.data.token breaks, and user session expires after 15 minutes without refresh flow.

findings.documented: Response shape is { total, page, page_size, results } using 1-indexed page parameter.
findings.actual: Response shape is { limit, offset, count, total, has_more, results } using offset-based pagination.
findings.how_found: Inspected the response payload of GET /v1/listings.
findings.impact: Frontend pagination logic expecting page and page_size fails to parse current page correctly.

findings.documented: Documented schema lists is_verified but makes no mention of is_live.
findings.actual: Records return an undocumented boolean field is_live which tracks active listings.
findings.how_found: Checked the keys in records returned by GET /v1/listings.
findings.impact: Crucial filtering for active listings would be missed without inspecting the raw payload.

findings.actual: GET /v1/listing/{listing_id} returns 404. The correct path is plural: GET /v1/listings/{listing_id}.
findings.how_found: Tested both singular and plural paths with listing ID DWE-3002501 in Postman.
findings.impact: Listing detail page fails with 404 if following the documented singular route.

findings.documented: Tokens are valid for 24 hours. There is no refresh flow.
findings.actual: Tokens expire in 900 seconds (15 minutes). An undocumented endpoint POST /auth/refresh exists to renew access tokens using refresh_token.
findings.how_found: Observed 401 error payload: 'access token expired - POST /auth/refresh with your refresh_token'.
findings.impact: Frontend crashes after 15 minutes unless an automatic token refresh interceptor is implemented.

findings.documented: Supports query parameter furnishing (unfurnished, semi-furnished, fully-furnished) to filter results.
findings.actual: The furnishing query parameter is silently ignored by the server; response returns mixed furnishing types (e.g. unfurnished, semi-furnished).
findings.how_found: Requested /v1/listings?furnishing=fully-furnished and observed unfurnished records in the response.
findings.impact: Frontend must implement client-side filtering for furnishing, otherwise users see incorrect property types.

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings in your city. Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side.
findings.actual: Server returns inactive listings where is_live is false.
findings.how_found: Called /v1/listings and found records with is_live: false.
findings.impact: Dead or inactive listings will be shown to users unless frontend explicitly filters for is_live === true.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are in Indian rupees, integer.
findings.actual: price_min is in Lakhs INR (float) and price_max is in Crores INR (float), not raw integer rupees.
findings.how_found: Inspected /v1/projects response where price_min is 80.0 and price_max is 3.22.
findings.impact: Project price ranges render incorrectly in frontend and project sorting/filtering by price breaks completely.

findings.documented: Logged-in user can save listings via GET, POST, and DELETE on /v1/favourites with body {'id': '...'}.
findings.actual: Returns 404 Not Found for /v1/favourites, /v1/favorites, and all user/session scoped variants.
findings.how_found: Tested GET, POST, and DELETE on /v1/favourites and alternate path spellings with valid Bearer token.
findings.impact: Favourites functionality cannot rely on the remote API; frontend or intermediate backend must handle user persistence locally.

findings.documented: Pre-computed aggregates for your city available via GET /v1/analytics/summary.
findings.how_found: Sent GET request to /v1/analytics/summary with valid auth headers.
findings.impact: Insights screen aggregates cannot be fetched directly and must be computed from raw dataset records.

findings.documented: Endpoints documented as GET /v1/favourites, POST /v1/favourites with body {'id': '...'}, and DELETE /v1/favourites/{id}.
findings.actual: Documented /v1/favourites endpoints return 404. The actual endpoint is /v1/saved, and POST /v1/saved requires {'listing_id': '...'} instead of {'id': '...'}.
findings.how_found: Tested alternate paths; /v1/saved responded with 422 validation error indicating 'listing_id' is required.
findings.impact: Saved listings functionality completely fails if implemented using documented /v1/favourites routes and payload.
